## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: alcohol and the law
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Decimal limits are kept exactly as printed: 0.08 and 0.04 per se limits, 0.05 risk level, 0.04 and 0.00 restoration restrictions, 0.15 interlock trigger [A02].
The page lists some DWI-law bullets before the chapter heading because of layout; facts were assigned to the physical page where each bullet appears [A01].
Penalty content is legal material and can change by legislation; it is marked dynamic and should be rechecked against the General Assembly site.
No sentencing lengths beyond those printed (such as jail duration) are stated, because the handbook does not give them.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
